privacy: Neutral invented messages, devices and receipts only; no tokens, push endpoints, chat IDs or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
title: Push first for briefs and update notices
goal: Brief-kind inbox items follow F-004-T09: push first, a tap counts as delivered, Telegram fallback after 10 minutes
acceptance: dispatchPushReminders (src/store-push.ts) or its successor pushes brief-kind items with a short title and a body cut to the push payload limit; the full text stays in the app
The Telegram loop (src/telegram.ts) treats a pushed brief like a pushed reminder: Telegram only through claimFallback; no device, or every push failed, sends at once as today
Approvals, replies and chat stay on Telegram (owner decision 2026-11-25); watch and session-limit notices share the brief kind and follow the same order (stated in the guide)
F-133-T01 passes unedited; test/push-first.test.ts still passes

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: the fallback claim and receipt exist (F-004-T09, F-124-T01); the work is the dispatch for brief kinds, the payload cut and the Telegram loop guard. Not a measurement.
